name: 唯一的归人欧丁加
prompt: A scarred man, god of the sole survivor, in a Western fantasy style. Short white hair, the left eye closed beneath an old scar, the right eye pale blue, a worn coat patched all over with a dozen scraps of different colours cut from the clothing of those who never came back. He sits by a small fire at a mountain pass or a camp gate at night, waiting, a long road empty before him. Palette: patchwork muted colours, fire orange, night blue, snow grey.

name: 疫棚里的凉风塞雷娜
prompt: A tall woman, goddess of fevers, in a Western fantasy style. Frost-grey hair in a single braid, pale blue eyes, a grey gown with sleeves rolled to the elbow, a white apron and cool hands, one hand laid on a patient's forehead in a canvas sickhouse. A basin of water beside her, cool mist rising from it, rows of cots in the soft grey light. She does not speak. Palette: frost grey, pale blue, linen white, cold water silver.

name: 初啼玛特罗娜
prompt: A round-faced midwife-goddess, in a Western fantasy style. Honey-coloured curls wrapped in a white cloth, warm amber eyes, laughing creases at the corners, a sturdy dress with a clean apron and warm hands. She holds a clean white cloth ready, sleeves pushed up, a kettle steaming on the hearth and a lamp lit in a plain wooden birthing room, golden sunlight through a small window, a cradle of woven willow waiting by the bed. A kind steady smile. Palette: honey gold, clean white, warm amber, soft brown.

name: 合创贝尔娜
prompt: A small woman, goddess of closing wounds, in a Western fantasy style. Red hair cut to the ears, a roll of linen bandage wound around one wrist, heavy firm hands, a brown field-surgeon's apron over a tunic, rolled sleeves and a satchel of lint and thread. She presses firmly on a soldier's wounded arm behind a battle line and the red turns to calm stillness. Palette: bandage white, brick red, canvas tan, smoke grey.

name: 无梦之枕希普诺
prompt: A long lean figure, god of dreamless sleep, in a Western fantasy style. Pale lilac hair to the waist, heavy half-lowered eyelids, a soft long grey wool gown with a hood, speaking softly as if afraid to wake someone. He carries a pillow of white linen and a small lamp turned low. He stands in a quiet dormitory hall at night, rows of sleepers perfectly still. Palette: lilac, soft grey, pillow white, deep quiet blue.

name: 续骨之掌奥斯坦
prompt: A short old man, god of mending bones, in a Western fantasy style. Short grey hair, two enormous hands with thick knuckles, a leather apron over a plain wool tunic, sleeves rolled, a calm patient face of long experience. He presses a hand to a soldier's broken leg in a stone courtyard with a row of splinted stretchers. A bone-setter's tools on a bench. Palette: warm grey, linen white, leather brown, soft daylight.

name: 黑暗里的暖手卢缇亚
prompt: A woman with eyes closed, goddess of guiding the blind, in a Western fantasy style. Black hair with a blue sheen, a plain dark hooded gown, one outstretched hand soft and warm with calluses at the palm. She leads a smoke-blinded soldier by the hand through the dark of a collapsed tunnel or a burning keep, a faint warm glow around her palm the only light. Palette: deep black, blue-black, warm hand-glow amber, smoke grey.

name: 青唇的药师菲洛缇
prompt: A lean woman, god of poison and antidote, in a Western fantasy style. Short dark-green hair, faintly blue lips, cool fingertips, a green apothecary's apron over a dark dress and a belt of small glass vials. She holds a cup under her nose to read what is in it. Shelves of jars and herbs in a low dispensary hut. Palette: dark green, vial glass, herb brown, pale lamplight.

name: 鸦羽的女王艾尔缪
prompt: A pale, dark-haired goddess of last journeys, in a Western fantasy style. Black hair, skin white as snow, a long crimson hooded cloak, eyes full of many reflected faces. A raven perches on her shoulder. She sits calmly beside a bed in a dim stone chamber, waiting. Through the narrow window the first snow of the year falls and a thin line of white settles on the sill, the raven turning its head toward the bed. The bed's occupant is only a quiet shape under a blanket. Palette: crimson, black raven, snow white, candle amber.

name: 代痛之身多萝缇
prompt: A barefoot young adult woman, goddess of the shared pain, properly dressed in a Western fantasy style. Short flax hair, misty blue eyes, a plain linen dress and a shawl, bruises of blue and purple on the backs of her hands. Light falls on the tops of her bare feet. She stands in the aisle of a field infirmary tent, a hand laid on a wounded soldier's shoulder. Palette: flax, bruise violet, misty blue, linen white.

name: 立誓者奥尔达
prompt: A veiled rider, god of oaths, in a Western fantasy style. A black gauze veil covering the face, eyes burning bright beneath it, a black riding cloak and fitted dark tunic, one hand with a stone ring engraved with two clasped hands. He rides a black horse without a mane along the foot of a long rampart at dusk. Palette: black, stone grey, ember eyes, dusk steel-blue.

name: 认输即止的剑杜兰迦
prompt: A tall lean swordsman-god, in a Western fantasy style. Old polished leather armour, a sword across the back never drawn in public, steady hands, short dark hair. He stands on the sanded floor of a dueling ground between two ranks of silent onlookers, one gauntleted hand resting on the pommel as if testing its steadiness. Banners of two rival houses hang at either end of the ring, a wooden fence and a low evening sun lengthening shadows across the sand. Palette: polished brown leather, steel, sand yellow, banner crimson.

name: 举盾者斯卡索
prompt: A broad old shield-bearer god, growing taller with every step, in a Western fantasy style. A great round shield held before him, an iron-rimmed helmet, mail shirt and surcoat, grey-streaked beard, a shield-arm braced as a wall, the shield dented and scored by countless blows but unmoved. He stands in a breach in a ruined rampart under a smoky sky, arrows glancing off the shield, tiny soldiers sheltering in a tight huddle behind him. Palette: iron grey, worn crimson surcoat, steel blue, dust.

name: 断后者雷格纳
prompt: A weathered spearman-god, in a Western fantasy style. A patched old cloak, a long spear, gambeson and mail, always the last to leave. He sits on a rock facing back along the road he came, hood down, spear upright in the earth beside him, his gaze fixed on the empty distance where the enemy will appear. Behind him a long column of retreating soldiers and carts dwindles into the dusk, banners furled, the first stars coming out. Palette: faded cloak brown, steel grey, dust, dim sky.

name: 鼓与号塔博伦
prompt: A broad-shouldered war-drum god, in a Western fantasy style. A great curved war horn on a strap across his chest that he never blows, breastplate, surcoat and cloak, heavy gauntlets. Behind him at the rear of a formation a row of war drums beats together by itself. He stands before a rank of spearmen holding a line. Palette: bronze horn, leather drum skin brown, banner red, steel.

name: 量墙的尺贝里昂
prompt: A craftsman-god of siegecraft, in a Western fantasy style. Hands covered in lime and rust, a master mason's leather apron over a tunic, a long folding measuring rule hanging at his belt, a plumb-line in his hand. He studies the base of a great stone wall, one palm on the masonry. Scaffolds and a siege tower in the background, dust and morning light. Palette: lime white, rust red, stone grey, scaffold timber brown.

name: 空鞘的老人帕克图
prompt: An old man dressed like a veteran soldier, god of truce, in a Western fantasy style. A worn gambeson and a grey cloak, an empty sword scabbard at his belt, white hair, a lined and peaceful face, hands folded on his knees. He sits motionless on a stone bench before a small hall with a tall bell tower, a bell mid-toll, banners lowered on both sides of an empty field. Palette: grey cloak, iron, dusk gold, quiet white.

name: 常新之疤弗尔穆
prompt: A young man like a new recruit, god of the first wound, in a Western fantasy style. A plain padded gambeson, helmet under one arm, a scar on the left arm always in the colour of a fresh cut, though it does not bleed. A mud-stained surcoat. He stands in the front rank of a green army about to march, a first line of fresh banners behind him. Palette: fresh banner red, green wool, polished steel, grey dawn.

name: 门前不灭的灯维特朗
prompt: A lame old veteran, god of homecoming, in a Western fantasy style. A rusted and patched mail coat of no known nation, a worn spear shaft as a staff, a wooden bowl, a roll of painted cloth and a stub of charcoal slung on his back. A lantern hangs lit beside him at a cottage door, and behind him a long road. He stands at the door at dusk, looking at a face in the lamplight. Palette: rust brown, lantern gold, dusk blue, charcoal black.
